purpose: Display existing MVS uncertainty and reference-check values on actual MVS points
authorization: 2026-10-23 user explicitly selected MVS actual point cloud coloring
sampling: First indices of the existing deterministic random-key-sorted source; display only
coordinates: Exact float32 XYZ bytes from the uncertainty computation's mvs_a/b_xyz.npy; no translation or surface fabrication

mapping.candidate_centres: prior patch centre + stored MVS face offset o * original patch normal
mapping.accept: lateral distance <= 0.5 m and absolute normal distance from stored MVS o <= 1 m
mapping.choose: minimum distance to candidate centre; ties resolved by ascending patch index
mapping.unmatched: not painted; never assign a value through an unmatched point

color: Original patch value for the selected MVS version and radius; point display count never enters chart statistics
prior_geometry: LoD2 face or original prior patch; explicitly labeled
legacy_geometry: Existing common LoD2 face/patch display remains selectable
coordinate_reference: EPSG:25832 lineage; existing COLMAP local coordinates and recorded world shift preserved
